manual_conclusions: Retained first failures and subsequent successes match their actual log summaries; initial fixture and setup errors are labeled as such.
The 38/47/32/43 totals have distinct focused scopes. Independent 2FAIL1PASS→3PASS, 3FAIL→3PASS and 2PASS records are separate; collection setup failure is retained.

Full CSRF field and truncated pytest prefix in Route development map consistently to the same placeholder. Known raw test token absent from all public bytes. No captured auth cookies/private keys or personal paths found by inspected fields and bounded scan.
Source/probe text uses original synthetic repository fixtures. Controlled approved-answer inputs are explicitly software-rule preconditions, not human approval or real learner evidence.
Historical final-source directories remain bounded post-run or before/after snapshots. Their hashes differ from later fixes where appropriate and are not portrayed as current source.
No seven-package document reviewed claims that the untracked development-worktree native restart was fixed-SHA acceptance. That record was not used in this audit to infer fixed-SHA success.

nonblocking_findings.detail: Nine private raw maps still point at live source paths that changed after earlier capture. Corresponding retained unchanged snapshot bytes match both raw and published hashes. Preserve those snapshots; do not validate them against current files or cite them as current implementation.

independence_limit: This was a fresh read-only verification pass, but this reviewer authored some underlying probes and packages. It is not independent authorship for all seven packages.
no_mutations: No repository/source/package modification, Git staging, test execution, browser action, or secret/material search.
